svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — The vegie patch’s biggest crop
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink editorial cartoon on a misty hill farm in the Otway Ranges, with tall gum trees, a weatherboard farmhouse with a water tank, a paddock fence, a tree fern and mesh-covered timber snail pens shaded by little wooden A-frames. A fictional older neighbour in a flat cap and flannel shirt proudly hands over a bucket heaped with garden snails, saying: They ate my lettuces for twenty years. Now they can be somebody’s entrée! A fictional farmer in a wide-brimmed hat, apron and gumboots holds one snail up delightedly and replies: Wonderful! Only 297,000 to go. Behind them a queue of other neighbours waits with buckets, jars and a wheelbarrow full of snails, and one snail is climbing the farmer’s gumboot.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
FINALLY, SOMEONE WANTS THE VEGIE PATCH’S BIGGEST CROP.
Source: ABC South West Victoria, 13 November 2026 — A new Otways farm aims to raise close to 300,000 snails for restaurants.
